projection.scope: Text-token scenario using this live presentation’s pricing_totals. Repeats the same observed input/output token mix for every customer workflow; no new cloud requests. Excludes vision input, image generation, audio, tools, taxes, discounts and hardware/support costs. Tokenizers, reasoning and output quality differ. Electricity is an assumption, not a wall-power measurement or throughput validation. Annual values are 12 30-day months at the dated rates, not a forecast.
